meta.name: Summarize GitHub trending repos with OpenAI and share via htmlhoster and DingTalk

name: GitHub Daily Trending → AI Insights → HTML Report → Push to Groups

parameters.content:
## GitHub Daily Trending → AI Insights → HTML Report → Push to Groups

**Flow**: Scheduled fetch of GitHub Trending → parse the list → fetch each repo's README → AI deep-dive → render into a single-file HTML → upload to htmlhoster for a public URL → push to DingTalk / Feishu groups.

### What you need to do (4 steps)
1. **1. Setup**: fill in AI endpoint / model, and DingTalk & Feishu webhooks (leave the rest as default).
2. **6. AI Analysis**: open the node → Authentication = **Generic Credential Type** → **Header Auth** → create a credential `Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx` (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works: OpenAI / DeepSeek / OpenRouter / SiliconFlow / Zhipu, etc.).
3. **7. Render HTML**: no changes needed, report styling is built-in.
4. **8. Upload to htmlhoster**: no API key required, 20 uploads/IP/day; the returned `entryUrl` is the public link.

### Notes
• The report page is **public** — do not put secrets or personal info in it.
• DingTalk uses milliseconds for the timestamp, Feishu uses seconds; the signing algorithms differ and are handled separately.
• If the bot security setting uses "Custom Keywords", just leave the secret empty.
• If AI fails the flow won't break — it degrades to a raw list page "without AI insights".

### Related links
• [HTML Hoster — host your HTML pages for free](https://htmlhoster.com/)
• [HTML Hoster Agent Upload API (no key · 20/day)](https://htmlhoster.com/agent/)

nodes.name: 6. AI Analysis
nodes.notes:
**Set credentials first**: Authentication = Generic Credential Type → Generic Auth Type = Header Auth → create a Header Auth credential, Name = `Authorization`, Value = `Bearer sk-xxxx`.

Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works — just change aiApiUrl / aiModel in **1. Setup**, e.g.:
• OpenAI `https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions` · gpt-4o-mini
• DeepSeek `https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions` · deepseek-chat
• OpenRouter `https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` · anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet
• SiliconFlow `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1/chat/completions` · Qwen/Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct

`neverError` is on, so an API error won't break the flow — it degrades to a plain list page "without AI insights". If the model doesn't support response_format=json_object, set aiJsonMode to false in **1. Setup**.

nodes.name: 8. Upload to htmlhoster
nodes.notes:
No API key required, 20 uploads/IP/day (https://htmlhoster.com/agent/).

Use a date-based filename (e.g. github-trending-2026-08-31.html) — htmlhoster now auto-detects the entry page from any HTML filename, so `entryUrl` is always non-null. `paths` must match the binary fileName and is passed through from the render node.

Returns entryUrl = public link; keep deleteToken in the n8n execution log for `DELETE /api/uploads/{id}` takedown — do not leak it. The page is public, so don't put secrets in it.
